description:
List the owners/permissions on a flow.
Returns: array of { principalId, principalType, roleName, principalDisplayName }.
Parameters: flow (required), environment (optional).
Uses Microsoft's unofficial api.flow.microsoft.com endpoint, which Microsoft labels unsupported; behavior may change.
Example: list_flow_owners { "flow": "<guid>" }

environment.description: Environment id (from list_environments). Omit to use the user's default environment.

name: list_flow_owners
